 Phoenix Suns 57 – 51 Golden State Warriors FINAL 
 Phoenix Suns defeated Golden State Warriors 57-51 in NBA at Chase Center. Relive the goals, key highlights, match stats and minute-by-minute recap on VAVEL.
 Coverage by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta Updated November 2, 2026, 11:27 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FINAL Last update 11:27 PM ET 11:27 PM ET 10 minutes ago Halftime Leaders: Top performers ahead of the second half
 Phoenix Suns: Devin Booker (16 PTS, 5-8 FG, 1-2 3PT, 2 AST), Miles Bridges (11 PTS, 4-6 FG, 1-2 3PT, 6 REB, 1 AST, 1 STL, 1 BLK), Oso Ighodaro (8 PTS, 3-3 FG, 1 REB, 1 BLK).
 Golden State Warriors: Stephen Curry (9 PTS, 2-7 FG, 1-5 3PT, 4 REB, 4 AST), Charles Bassey (9 PTS, 4-6 FG, 2 REB), Yaxel Lendeborg (8 PTS, 3-7 FG, 2-4 3PT, 2 REB, 3 AST, 1 STL).
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 Key moments
 11:04 PM ET 2Q | 2:59: Brandin Podziemski and Devin Booker… 
 10:02 PM ET Starters set on the court as tip-off approaches 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 11:22 PM ET 15 minutes ago Halftime Stats: Phoenix efficiency from the floor sets the pace over Golden State
 The Phoenix Suns carry a 57-51 halftime edge thanks to efficient shooting, knocking down 19-of-37 from the field (51%) and 6-of-14 from three-point range (43%) alongside 18 rebounds and 12 assists. The Golden State Warriors remain right within striking distance despite shooting 18-of-44 overall (41%) and 7-of-24 from beyond the arc (29%), while holding a 20-18 rebounding advantage and recording 11 assists before Brandin Podziemski missed a 25-foot step-back triple at the horn.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:16 PM ET 20 minutes ago Halftime: Suns 57-51 Warriors
 The second-quarter buzzer sounds! Phoenix Suns and Golden State Warriors head into the halftime locker room at 57–51 . First-half scoring leaders: Devin Booker (16 PTS, 5-8 FG, 1-2 3PT, 2 AST) for Suns, and Stephen Curry (9 PTS, 2-7 FG, 1-5 3PT, 4 REB, 4 AST) for Warriors.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:09 PM ET 27 minutes ago 2Q | 1:24: The Warriors battle within 6 as possessions tighten
 Stephen Curry went 2-for-2 at the stripe, before Draymond Green went 2-for-2 at the stripe. Moments later, Brandin Podziemski buried a three-pointer set up by Stephen Curry , leaving the scoreboard at Suns 55, Warriors 49 with 1:24 remaining in the 2nd Quarter. On the stat sheet, Devin Booker (14 PTS, 5-8 FG, 1-2 3PT, 2 AST) paces the Suns while Charles Bassey (9 PTS, 4-6 FG, 2 REB) leads the Warriors.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 11:04 PM ET 33 minutes ago 2Q | 2:59: Brandin Podziemski and Devin Booker trade buckets before halftime
 Devin Booker stayed aggressive for Phoenix by knocking down a pair of free throws and hitting an eight-foot pull-up jumper to reach a game-high 14 points on 5-of-8 shooting. Golden State responded after checking Stephen Curry and Draymond Green back onto the floor, as Brandin Podziemski buried a 26-foot step-back three-pointer to trim the Suns' lead to 55-42. Green then corralled the defensive rebound off a Dillon Brooks miss with 2:59 left.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:57 PM ET 40 minutes ago 2Q | 4:30: Yaxel Lendeborg heats up on the offensive end
 Charles Bassey knocked down a jumper off a crisp feed from Yaxel Lendeborg , before Dillon Brooks knocked down a pair at the foul line. Moments later, Devin Booker splashed a deep 26-foot triple on a dime from Jalen Green and Yaxel Lendeborg splashed a deep 27-foot triple, leaving the scoreboard at Suns 51, Warriors 39 with 4:30 remaining in the 2nd Quarter. On the stat sheet, Miles Bridges (11 PTS, 4-6 FG, 1-2 3PT, 5 REB, 1 AST, 1 STL, 1 BLK) paces the Suns while Charles Bassey (9 PTS, 4-6 FG, 2 REB) leads the Warriors.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:50 PM ET an hour ago 2Q | 0.0: The Suns hold a 44-29 advantage in the 2nd quarter
 Miles Bridges splashed a deep 27-foot triple, before Will Richard drained a perimeter triple off an assist from Georges Niang . Moments later, Luke Kennard drained a perimeter triple off an assist from Miles Bridges and Stephen Curry sank both free throws, leaving the scoreboard at Suns 44, Warriors 29 with 0.0 remaining in the 2nd Quarter. On the stat sheet, Miles Bridges (11 PTS, 4-6 FG, 1-2 3PT, 5 REB, 1 AST, 1 STL, 1 BLK) paces the Suns while Georges Niang (7 PTS, 3-4 FG, 3 REB, 2 AST) leads the Warriors.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:44 PM ET an hour ago 2Q | 0.0: Luke Kennard buries a triple as Phoenix holds a 14-point advantage
 Luke Kennard opened the second-quarter action by burying a 25-foot three-pointer off a feed from Ryan Dunn , before Jalen Green blocked a perimeter look by De'Anthony Melton and Miles Bridges intercepted a Gary Payton II pass. Stephen Curry then corralled a defensive rebound and set up Georges Niang for a layup inside, keeping the Phoenix Suns ahead of the Golden State Warriors, 35-21.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:39 PM ET an hour ago End of 1Q: Suns lead 31-19
 Both half-court defenses have clamped down over the past few possessions. With 0:00 remaining in the 1st Quarter, Phoenix Suns holds a 31–19 lead.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:33 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 2:10: Momentum swings on the hardwood in the 1st quarter
 Charles Bassey cleaned up the offensive glass with a putback, before Jordan Goodwin knocked down a jumper off an assist from Luke Kennard . Moments later, Oso Ighodaro finished through traffic inside off an assist from Devin Booker and Collin Gillespie splashed a deep 27-foot triple off a crisp feed from Jordan Goodwin , leaving the scoreboard at Suns 25, Warriors 15 with 2:10 remaining in the 1st Quarter. On the stat sheet, Dillon Brooks (5 PTS, 1-1 FG, 1-1 3PT, 1 REB, 2 AST) paces the Suns while Charles Bassey (3 PTS, 1-2 FG, 2 REB) leads the Warriors.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:26 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 5:59: The Suns hold a 16-10 advantage in the 1st quarter
 Dillon Brooks drained a perimeter triple off an assist from Devin Booker , before Draymond Green converted in the paint set up by Georges Niang . Moments later, Georges Niang knocked down a jumper and Jalen Green knocked down a jumper, leaving the scoreboard at Suns 16, Warriors 10 with 5:59 remaining in the 1st Quarter. On the stat sheet, Dillon Brooks (5 PTS, 1-1 FG, 1-1 3PT, 1 REB, 2 AST) paces the Suns while Stephen Curry (3 PTS, 1-4 FG, 1-3 3PT) leads the Warriors.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:20 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 7:56: The Warriors battle within 5 as possessions tighten
 Stephen Curry splashed a deep 26-foot triple off a crisp feed from Draymond Green , before Miles Bridges sliced into the lane for a driving finish on a dime from Dillon Brooks . Moments later, Will Richard drained a perimeter triple off an assist from Brandin Podziemski and Devin Booker converted in the paint set up by Dillon Brooks , leaving the scoreboard at Suns 11, Warriors 6 with 7:56 remaining in the 1st Quarter. On the stat sheet, Devin Booker (5 PTS, 2-3 FG) paces the Suns while Stephen Curry (3 PTS, 1-2 FG, 1-1 3PT) leads the Warriors.
 Updates by Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta
 10:14 PM ET an hour ago 1Q | 11:36: High-tempo sequence between the Suns and Warriors
 Both half-court defenses have clamped down over the past few possessions. With 11:36 remaining in the 1st Quarter, Suns and Warriors are tied at 0–0 .

 Pre-game introductions are complete at Chase Center (San Francisco) and the starting units for Phoenix Suns and Golden State Warriors are taking their places for tip-off.

 Two-time MVP Stephen Curry and Draymond Green lead the Golden State Warriors onto the Chase Center floor in San Francisco for a Pacific Division showdown.

 All-NBA guard Devin Booker headlines the Phoenix Suns' offensive attack as Phoenix visits the Bay Area for a late-night Western Conference battle.

 Both Phoenix Suns and Golden State Warriors are wrapping up their pre-game routines as the coaching staffs finalize their opening rotations and tactical matchups for tip-off.

 Players from both Phoenix Suns and Golden State Warriors are on the court at Chase Center (San Francisco) going through their final pre-game warmups and position drills ahead of tip-off.

 The shooting clinic between Stephen Curry's off-ball relocation and Devin Booker's mid-range and perimeter scoring makes this a must-watch West Coast finale.

 All eyes at Chase Center will be on the star duel between Stephen Curry (Golden State Warriors) and Devin Booker (Phoenix Suns). Both headline talents enter tonight's NBA clash as the primary offensive engines for their rosters.

 7:58 PM ET 4 hours ago The venue: Chase Center sets the stage in San Francisco
 Chase Center in San Francisco is buzzing ahead of tonight's NBA showdown between Golden State Warriors and Phoenix Suns . Fans are filing into the arena as pregame warmups get underway.

 Both sides are finalizing preparations inside the locker rooms at Chase Center . Golden State Warriors will lean heavily on star playmaker Stephen Curry , while Phoenix Suns looks to Devin Booker to set the tone early.

 Jhonatan Andrés Martínez Cuesta has been director of VAVEL's Colombia edition since 2018. He joined VAVEL in 2014 as a writer and worked as a coordinator before taking charge of the edition. Based in Medellín, he covers Colombian football — especially the Antioquia clubs and Independiente Medellín — as well as international and women's football, cycling and other sports, and has covered thousands of matches live for VAVEL's Colombia, Mexico and US editions. He is a systems engineer, trained as a television and media technician, and works as a communicator for Club Real Antioquia's youth teams.
